# Durable onboarding Planner handoff (S8)

S8 turns only an exact S7 `READY` result into a durable, non-executable
Learning Planner admission. It does not create or reserve a course, learning
path, lesson, NBA, or Practice object, and it does not call AI Prompt or mutate
Student. Planner must re-read current state and atomically reserve any future
execution in S9.

## Rollout

S11 makes the full capability chain an admission gate rather than a response
selector. A request with no prior evidence is admitted only when dense
ordering, canonical actions, unified coordination, product readiness, and the
Planner handoff are all enabled; it is always stamped and returned as session
v3. Disabling any flag stops new admission before Teacher, Dialog, Student, or
Planner side effects. Exact already-admitted v1/v2/v3 interactions, coordinator
jobs, handoffs, and terminal action receipts continue from durable evidence and
are never upgraded or downgraded by current flags.

Install migration 023 with all old writers quiesced and its drain probe clean.
Do not run S10 and S11 writers concurrently after installation. Rollback is
behavioural only: stop new admission, let persisted coordinator/handoff/terminal
work recover, and retain migration 023. Its down migration deliberately refuses
stamped interaction or terminal-session evidence. A terminal historical row
without one exact reconstructible projection returns non-retryable HTTP 409
`historical_session_unavailable`; it never falls back to current state or the
latest Student record.

`TEACHER_ONBOARDING_PLANNER_HANDOFF_ENABLED=false` remains the default. Enabling
it requires product-aware onboarding, dense Dialog ordering, canonical actions,
and the unified coordinator. Before migration 023, S8-off requests retained
the S7 session contract. After the S11 cutover they are not newly admitted;
the handoff worker and session reader still finish exact already-admitted
evidence after a flag rollback.

Teacher uses the dedicated `LEARNING_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN`, which must match
Planner's `TEACHER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_INTERNAL_TOKEN` and must differ from the
general readiness/course-plan token. It may be empty only while S8 is dark and
there is no pending local ledger work. A non-empty token is always checked for
dedication, even with admissions off. Teacher probes migration `021` at
startup: a deploy before that migration remains S7-compatible and sends no
handoff-table queries; an enabled admission flag then fails readiness until the
migration is present. Once the ledger exists, admissions can be disabled to
drain it, but a missing handoff token makes readiness fail safely while pending
rows remain.

## Frozen wire contract

Teacher sends a capped strict JSON request with a stable UUID
`Idempotency-Key`:

```json
{
  "schema": "teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1",
  "expected_state_ref": {"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": 4},
  "dialog_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
  "teacher_job_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"
}
```

`teacher_job_id` is the stable handoff command identity, not an executable job.
The exact request hash includes the path Student identity and JSON request.
A first success is `201`, an exact replay is `200`, and both carry strict
`teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1`:

```json
{
  "schema": "teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1",
  "handoff_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
  "status": "ACCEPTED",
  "state_ref": {"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": 4},
  "goal": {"code": "programming.foundation", "version": "v1", "graph_version": "programming-foundation-graph-v1"},
  "execution_status": "NOT_STARTED",
  "content_status": "NOT_CREATED",
  "readiness_observed_at": "2026-09-11T12:00:00Z",
  "replayed": false
}
```

The client requires JSON content type, one bounded object, no unknown fields,
canonical UTC `readiness_observed_at`, and exact state/goal identity. A `409`
body is also strict and capped: `idempotency_conflict` blocks;
`state_changed` or `active_path_exists` re-resolves only the frozen state.
Unknown or malformed `400`, `409`, and `422` errors are invalid responses and
fail closed. Exact `invalid_student_id`, `invalid_idempotency_key`,
`invalid_request`, and `not_ready` are rejected; `5xx` and timeouts retry the
same command.

## Durable recovery

`teacher_onboarding_plan_handoff` is unique by Student and exact state-ref,
independent of goal. It stores stable Planner and notification commands,
request hash, bounded origin references, lease/retry checkpoints, accepted
handoff ID, and `readiness_observed_at`. It stores no profile, model/prompt or
message body, opaque graph payload, or content identity.

Its identity fields (Student/Teacher/Dialog, source and command IDs, request
hash, state-ref, goal, locale, and notification command) are database
immutable. Lifecycle leases, retries and acknowledgement checkpoints may
advance, but ledger evidence cannot be updated into another command or deleted
or truncated. Planner acceptance and Dialog delivery acknowledgement tuples
are independently write-once: retries can never erase or replace either
remote acknowledgement.

For an S5 accepted Student effect, enqueue, prompt transition to
`handoff_pending`, and source-job lease release are atomic. The dense cursor
does not advance. A worker checkpoints Planner `ACCEPTED` before appending the
deterministic message. If either remote acknowledgement is lost, restart reuses
the same idempotency key. Only verified Dialog delivery atomically completes
the source job/turn/interaction, writes its outcome, advances the cursor, and
marks the handoff delivered. `ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS`, no-effect, tangent,
clarification, and unsupported readiness never enqueue.

Rollback is intentionally fail-closed. The down migration locks the handoff
and interaction tables in `ACCESS EXCLUSIVE` mode, then refuses to proceed
after any ledger row or `handoff_pending` evidence exists. This migration is
reversible only for an unused, empty install. Operational rollback means turn
off new admissions and let the worker drain while permanently retaining the
table and receipts; no delete, truncate, or export-and-drop path exists.

## Browser projection

S8 ensure returns `teacher-onboarding-session.v3` and preserves v1/v2 replay:

- `COLLECTING` has the existing phase, exact state ref, and current prompt;
- `HANDOFF_PENDING` has `PREPARING_PATH` plus terminal kind, safe display name,
  and `content_status=NOT_CREATED`;
- `PLANNER_HANDOFF_ACCEPTED` has `READY_TO_START`, safe display name,
  `execution_status=NOT_STARTED`, and `content_status=NOT_CREATED`;
- `ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS` has `READY_TO_START` and only its terminal kind.

No Planner handoff, graph, course, path, or lesson ID is returned to the
browser. The deterministic accepted message explicitly says preparation has
not started and no course, path, or lessons were created.

## S9 Planner outcome boundary

The optional S9 consumer is enabled only with
`TEACHER_ONBOARDING_PATH_OUTCOME_ENABLED=true` and migration `022`; it is
otherwise absent so an S7/S8 database remains compatible. It consumes only
the exact `planner.onboarding-path.outcome.v1` subject and strict v1 envelope:

```json
{
  "event_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",
  "event_type": "planner.onboarding-path.outcome.v1",
  "correlation_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005",
  "causation_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
  "student_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006",
  "occurred_at": "2026-09-11T12:00:00Z",
  "schema_version": 1,
  "data": {
    "schema": "planner-onboarding-path-outcome.v1",
    "execution_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005",
    "handoff_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
    "student_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006",
    "dialog_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000007",
    "teacher_job_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000008",
    "status": "PATH_READY",
    "course_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000009",
    "learning_path_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000010",
    "first_lesson_id": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000011"
  }
}
```

`correlation_id` equals `execution_id`, `causation_id` equals `handoff_id`,
and all Student/Dialog/Teacher identities must match the immutable S8 handoff
row. `PATH_READY` requires the three content IDs; `ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS` and
`STATE_CHANGED` forbid them. Teacher persists the event/execution inbox before
appending exactly one localized personal-teacher message with `event_id` as
the Dialog idempotency key. The event never carries profile, graph, provider,
raw error, or browser/UI data. Ensure still re-reads Planner's authoritative
Student state and exposes only the existing v3 `ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS` terminal;
the event itself never grants browser navigation.

After the localized Dialog append is durably checkpointed, a fresh v3 Ensure
may expose only `path_outcome={kind,status,dialog_message_id}`. The query joins
the delivered inbox row back to the exact current S8 Student, PersonalTeacher,
Dialog, Teacher job, and state reference. `kind` is
`ONBOARDING_PATH_OUTCOME`; the exposed statuses are `PATH_READY` and
`ACTIVE_PATH_EXISTS`. The marker omits all Planner and content identities and
is only a reconciliation fence: Student and Course remain authoritative for
the path and first lesson.
